انفلتن (form VII)
# اِنْفَلَتُّنَّ (infalattunna) /in.fa.lat.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِنْفَلَتَ (infalata)
# اِنْفَلَتْنَ (infalatna) /in.fa.lat.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْفَلَتَ (infalata)
# اِنْفَلِتْنَ (infalitna) /in.fa.lit.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْفَلَتَ (infalata)
